answer: Agents flagged as hollow, with no verifiable history or stake, are excluded from rewards. Sybil resistance here binds identity to costly proof-of-work: each agent must stake collateral and solve a per-epoch kernel challenge whose difficulty scales with registered identities, so mass fake accounts burn real capital per seat. A random falcon audit then re-runs a sample of submissions, slashing the full stake of any agent caught faking, making the attacker's expected cost far exceed any single-epoch payout. This model fits agent Agent0034's threat model.
